metadata.title: Triam Udom English Error Identification Batch 1

questions.question: Choose the incorrect part: The group of students / are / preparing / for the competition.
questions.explanationThai: group เป็นคำนามเอกพจน์ ต้องใช้ is ไม่ใช่ are

questions.question: Choose the incorrect part: She has finished / her homework / two hours ago / before dinner.
questions.explanationThai: two hours ago เป็นเวลาที่จบแล้ว ต้องใช้ past simple

questions.question: Choose the incorrect part: The letters / was sent / yesterday / by the secretary.
questions.explanationThai: letters เป็นพหูพจน์ ต้องใช้ were sent

questions.question: Choose the incorrect part: He suggested / to take / a taxi / home.
questions.explanationThai: suggest ตามด้วย gerund: suggested taking

questions.question: Choose the incorrect part: The book / who / I borrowed / is interesting.
questions.explanationThai: book เป็นสิ่งของ ใช้ which หรือ that

questions.question: Choose the incorrect part: If I knew / the answer, / I will tell / you.
questions.explanationThai: Conditional type 2 ใช้ would tell

questions.question: Choose the incorrect part: He said / that he is / tired / yesterday.
questions.explanationThai: Reported speech ควรเปลี่ยน is เป็น was

questions.question: Choose the incorrect part: She is good / in / mathematics / at school.
questions.explanationThai: good at ไม่ใช่ good in

questions.question: Choose the incorrect part: This car is / more cheaper / than / that one.
questions.explanationThai: cheap ขั้นกว่าใช้ cheaper ไม่ใช้ more cheaper

questions.question: Choose the incorrect part: There are / much students / in the classroom / today.
questions.explanationThai: students นับได้ ใช้ many students

questions.explanationThai: Conditional type 2 ใช้ would tell

questions.question: Choose the incorrect part: She is good / in / mathematics / at school.
questions.explanationThai: good at ไม่ใช่ good in

questions.explanationThai: cheap ขั้นกว่าใช้ cheaper ไม่ใช้ more cheaper

questions.question: Choose the incorrect part: There are / much students / in the classroom / today.
questions.explanationThai: students นับได้ ใช้ many students
